rubric_items.reason: countByStatus, service status_counts and the page counts line/links are all tested; the multi-page 21-row cases (S-2 AC1, S-4 AC2) and the range-change sum check (S-2 AC4) are not exercised despite being listed as covered.
Assertions check exact count objects, key order, sum vs total, exact rendered line and link query params; the page-2 test only compares counts against an empty page from a 5-row fixture.

Zero counts, no matches, other doctor/patient, local-day boundary, status replacement, 400 invalid status and failed fetch are covered; the inclusion side of the day boundary uses a midday slot, not a late-evening one.
Vitest+Supertest with own fresh database and injected clock for API, Vitest+jsdom+Testing Library with stubbed fetch and MemoryRouter for web; test names start with HMS-30 REQ-n.
No pass counts or coverage numbers are stated; the artifact defers results to checks.json and notes the verifier skips coverage, matching checks.json (coverage status skip).

findings.text: S-2 AC1 and S-4 AC2 need 21 matching appointments (20 rows on page 1, 21st on page 2). The fixture has 5 rows, so page 2 is empty and no test checks 20-row paging or a page-2 row in the counts, yet the artifact lists S-4 and S-2 AC1 as covered.

cites.quote: S-4: covered by the API order/envelope and invalid-status tests and the web table/filter test.
Given a doctor's list with 21 matching appointments, when staff open page 1, then the table shows 20 rows and the 21st appointment appears on page 2.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a test with 21 matching appointments for one doctor (21st No-show): assert page 1 has 20 rows, page 2 has the 21st, and page 1 NO_SHOW count includes it; or narrow the Known claims.

findings.text: S-2 AC4 asks that counts add up to the total before and after changing the date range; the sum-equals-total check runs for one range only, and S-4 AC3 (rows and total follow a new range) has no dedicated assertion.

cites.quote: when staff read the counts and then change the date range and read them again, then each time the four displayed counts add up to the displayed total

findings.suggested_fix: Repeat the sum-equals-total and total assertions for a second range (e.g. MONDAY..WEDNESDAY).

findings.text: The local-day boundary test's inclusion case is a Tuesday 11:45 (midday) slot, not the late-evening 23:30 local case S-2 AC2 describes, so it is weaker than the story's edge on the inclusion side.

cites.quote: an appointment at 11:45 on the last day is counted
one Completed appointment at 23:30 local on 10 March

findings.suggested_fix: Insert a late-evening appointment on the last local day directly (as done for Wednesday 01:00) and assert it is counted.

cites.quote: API tests use Vitest and Supertest against a throwaway PostgreSQL 16 with a fixed clock.
Vitest with jsdom and Testing Library
Every PRD requirement has at least one test whose name starts with its ID
APT-9: lists by doctor or patient, with date range and status, ordered by start
